'''Patrol troopers ''' were a variant of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] present on [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. They wore combat gear, and were further armed with [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] and [[Stun baton/Legends|stun batons]].<ref name="Lure" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial patrol trooper first appeared in the Fantasy Flight Games roleplaying supplement bonus adventure ''[[Lure of the Lost]]''.<ref name="Lure" />
